testCases.input: Is there any available job for any of those skills?
testCases.actualOutput:
Yes, there are several job openings that require these skills. Based on the provided context, here are examples of positions that involve these areas:

*   **Farm Manager/Gårdsansvarig:** Multiple listings (e.g., jobs #1739844, #1812660, #1830982, #1899103) require responsibility for the daily operation and maintenance of the farm, including crops, gardens, and equipment.
*   **Operations Manager (Driftledare Växtodling/SLU Lanna Property):** Jobs such as #1856862 and #1702404 specifically seek managers to plan and implement the crop year, handle operational economics, and oversee production processes on a large scale.
*   **Agronomist - Horticulture Officer (#1940197):** This role involves the design and supervision of cultivation programs, management of quality assurance systems, and coordination of the production procedure.
*   **Crop Cultivation Adviser (#1717705, #1708081, #1840380):** These positions involve advising agricultural companies on crop cultivation planning, field advice, and financial follow-up of crops.
*   **Machine Operator/Tractor Driver (#1853395, #1772492, #1657697, #156744):** These roles are responsible for the practical execution of crop production tasks, including tillage, sowing, crop inspection, harvesting, and machine maintenance.
*   **Expert/Project Manager in Milk for Sustainable Animal Production (#134508, #1641777):** These roles involve gathering and coordinating competences to contribute to sustainable animal production, including breeding, feed, and production economics.
*   **Agronomic R&D Researcher/Specialist (#1800329, #1826529, #45646):** These positions focus on the development of innovative products, experimentation, and support for the technical or commercial departments within the agricultural industry.
*   **Support Manager with knowledge of agriculture (#1913493):** This role involves supporting plant growers with digital solutions for precision agriculture and field planning.
*   **Lantbrukare med huvudansvar för jordbruk och djurhållning (#1854878):** This role includes primary responsibility for organic agriculture and animal husbandry, including administrative work related to farm support and crop rotations.

Many of these roles require a combination of these skills, such as knowledge of crop production principles, production processes, and the ability to optimize production while managing farm products.

title: Animal welfare officer
description: When you work at the county board, you get to use your knowledge at the country's broadest authority. The county board is the state's representative in the county and ensures that national goals are achieved. Taking regional conditions into account, we make trade-offs between different societal interests. This is through collaboration between experts in a range of different fields and in collaboration with authorities, municipalities and organisations. At the county board, we create social benefit and influence social development, every day. It is an important assignment, a great responsibility and an inspiring opportunity. Let your knowledge become a force for Östergötland. We are looking for Östergötland is a vibrant agricultural county with extensive animal husbandry. We are now looking for an animal welfare officer to strengthen our unit. The position is a permanent, full-time position that begins with a 6-month trial period. Access as soon as possible and according to agreement. You will belong to the Animal Protection Unit, which has an expert function for the county board's assignments to operate throughout the food chain for healthy food, good animal welfare and protection of property and people in accordance with the Act on the Supervision of Dogs and Cats. A large part of the unit's activities includes animal welfare control. The unit for animal protection is included together with the unit for food, veterinary and game, the unit for agricultural support and the unit for rural areas in the department for animals, rural areas and food. Your duties As an animal welfare officer, you work with animal welfare cases of various nature. You will work with both routine inspections of the farm's animals and complaint cases about lack of animal protection, permits for professional activities with horses or companion animals, as well as subsequent processing of any decisions. You may also be needed for other tasks at the unit, such as enforcement of custody orders. Depending on your skills and education, other tasks may also become relevant within the department for animals, rural areas and food such as animal control, area control, primary production control or the like. Required requirements for the position - You have at least a bachelor's degree in agronomy, ethology and animal welfare, biology, farm manager or other education that we deem relevant. - You have experience and good knowledge of several different animal species. - You have a good ability to express yourself in Swedish in speech and writing. - You have good knowledge of the agricultural industry. - You have previous experience of official work in animal welfare. - You have good knowledge of the Office package. - You have good knowledge of Platina. - You have good knowledge of the animal welfare control register. - You have a B driving licence. Meritorious for the position - Documented experience of working with farm animals. - Good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge of administration and confidentiality. As a person - Do you have high cooperation skills by working well with other people. You relate to them in a responsive and flexible way. You listen, communicate and resolve conflicts in a constructive way. - Are you service oriented in that you are calm, attentive and accommodating in your treatment. You have an interest, desire and ability to help others and make an effort to deliver solutions. - Are you structured in that you plan, organize and prioritize your work effectively. You set and keep time frames. - Are you stable in that you are calm and controlled in stressful situations or pressured situations. You maintain a realistic perspective on situations and focus on the right things. - You have a high ability for oral communication, this is because you will have a lot of contact with animal keepers and sometimes also with the media. This means that you speak clearly, articulately and engaged in individual meetings and in small and large groups. You listen and are receptive to the other party and adapt to the situation. About us as an authority, our benefits and other conditions Östergötland County Administrative Board is a state authority and our office is located in central Linköping. As employed by us, you have, among other things, wellness hours, wellness allowance, extended parental allowance and flexible working hours. We offer the option of remote work up to two days a week on average if the business allows. For us, it is important that our workplace is characterized by consideration, respect and communication and according to the state's core values. Read more about us, our benefits, our core values ​​and what it's like to work with us. https://www. the county board. see/ostergotland/about-us/work-with-us. htmlThe County Administrative Board has an important coordinating role in the event of social disturbances, and thus all employees are included in the crisis and war organization. Some of our services are security classified, which means that a security check will then be carried out before employment. If you want to know more, contact Head of Unit, Helen Loor, tel. 010-223 52 59. Union representative for SACO is Magnus Roback, tel. 010-223 54 89 and for ST is Nina Stenmark, tel. 010-223 53 04. Welcome with your application, which you send via www. which one. com. Your application must have been received no later than 2024-11-14, enter ref no: 17395.

jobId: 134508
title: Expert/project manager in milk for sustainable animal production
description: Do you have knowledge of and experience in milk production? Do you want to work with the sustainable milk production of the future together with companies and the consultancy in the agricultural and animal sector? Then this could be a service for you! About us The government wishes to strengthen competitiveness in animal production for food by ensuring that the newest knowledge nationally and internationally is useful for Swedish producers. Knowledge hub animal production is a new unit within RISE that we are building together with experts in the field and who have competence in knowledge transfer, advice and communication. Together with the actors, we will identify the needs of animal production and develop models and advisory methods, which will put the knowledge to use by the farmer. The knowledge hub should not conduct research or advice itself, but be a link between the research and the advice and should collect knowledge from different areas and make it useful for advisory companies and the farmers. About the role We are now expanding our team with another expert in the field of milk production. As an expert in our team, you get the opportunity to work with acquisition, compilation and transfer of knowledge regarding milk production, animal health and welfare, breeding, feed, milk quality, new technology and entrepreneurship. This is for a future sustainable Swedish animal production, which contributes to good animal welfare and working environment, together with good profitability. You will be an important team player in a committed department with high competence and who values ​​working in close collaboration with both colleagues within RISE and with our partners. You will have an important key role where you gather and coordinate different competences in milk production with our experts, industry partners and other RISE competencies, to contribute to knowledge transfer based on the animal producer's current and future needs. The position is located in Uppsala or Lund and involves some travel, therefore a B driving license is a requirement. Who are you? You have an education at at least university level as an agronomist, veterinarian, farm manager or equivalent. You have experience and knowledge of the entire milk production process, i.e. knowledge within i.a. animal health, breeding, feed, production economics and management. We would like you to have experience of working interdisciplinary, as well as working with information delivery and identifying farmers' knowledge needs, in national/international projects. It is advantageous if you have several years of work experience in the field of milk production, information efforts/further training and counseling for agricultural entrepreneurs. As a person, you are focused, committed, driven and good at building relationships with e.g. You work goal-oriented and structured and have a strong ability to quickly absorb information and events. Your way of thinking is strategic and you have a good overall view. You are proactive and systematic in your way of working and like to think new things. Very good knowledge of Swedish and English, both spoken and written, is a requirement. What do we offer you? With us at RISE, you will get to work with an incredibly broad and exciting business. You will be part of a network of experts where you will be given the opportunity to exchange experience and develop skills as well as a valuable sounding board. You will collaborate with our researchers and experts in agricultural production. The culture is characterized by a positive spirit where everything is possible and where we work focused towards our common goals. You will work in a dynamic environment that gives you development opportunities both professionally and personally. At RISE, we want you to succeed and feel good, because when you succeed, you contribute to a sustainable future. Do you want to know more? Welcome to contact Jørgen Korning, Head of Unit, 070-313 6996. The deadline for applications is 10 November 2024. Interviews will take place continuously during and after the application period. Our union representatives are: Ingemar Petermann, SACO 010-2284122 and Linda Ikatti, 010-516 51 61. Calls from external recruitment companies and sellers are kindly avoided as we are subject to the Public Procurement Act.

Diagnosing diseases and determining the best treatment.
Ration monitoring and improvement suggestions.

Recommendations to improve animal husbandry standards and/or unit procedures.

Veterinary Degree.
Professional License.
Minimum of 5 years of experience, preferably in sheep and goats.
Good knowledge of vaccination protocols.
Team spirit and effective communication skills.
Good knowledge of English language.
Good computer skills (MS Office, outlook).
Driver's license holder.
Possibility of travel within Greece, to our livestock units.

Provided:

Stable work environment.
Group insurance.
Training in modern sheep and goat management methods.
Development prospects.

Be part of our great team and send your CV!

description: The Department of Plant Production Ecology We are looking for an experimental technician for Röbäcksdalen's field research station, Umeå. Do you want to contribute to the development of Swedish agriculture by participating and testing agricultural issues in field experiments? Do you enjoy solving problems and are you service oriented? Then this position at SLU in Umeå could be something for you. We are now looking for an employee who can contribute to continued development and management of the business. Together with colleagues, you will carry out research-oriented special trials, testing of new breeding material of forage crops, straw grain and potatoes as well as long-range cultivation system, fertility and tillage trials. All this is carried out under field conditions within both conventional and organic cultivation systems. About the job The main work task will consist of the establishment and maintenance and harvesting of field trials in the field of crop cultivation, but participation in departmental joint activities and assisting and supervising temporary field staff are examples of other tasks that may occur .During the crop growing season, the work mainly takes place in the field. The tasks then mainly include planning and implementation of practical steps linked to the experiments. Important work steps are then tillage, sowing, crop protection measures and harvesting, but the work also consists of weighing seed and fertilizer, simpler measurements in the field, grading and sampling of soil and plant material. Between the growing seasons, we work at the experimental station mainly with result processing, follow-up and documentation of trials, planning for the coming season, technical maintenance of machines, development of trial methodology and planning of future trials together with researchers and other trial orderers. The work is teamwork, where responsibility is distributed within the group, and where communication and cooperation are crucial for a successful result. Please note that due to the relatively short growing season, the work is intensive, occasionally physically demanding and irregular working hours and overtime work occur during the growing season. Your background We are looking for you who:• is interested in research and development• appreciates collaborating with researchers and companies• is technically interested and who easily adopts new technology• wants to work practically on a agriculturally oriented experimental station• enjoys working outdoors• can work independently• is meticulous It is required that you:• be educated in the field of agriculture (agricultural high school or agrotechnician, land surveyor or agronomist training or equivalent)• have good computer skills• command spoken and written Swedish and can communicate in English• holds a B driving license It is advantageous if you have practical agricultural experience in crop cultivation or hold authorization to use plant protection products (class 1L-2L).We will attach great importance to your personal qualities, such as cooperativeness, accuracy and independence.About usThe Department of Plant Production Ecology contributes to solutions through research, collaboration and education about sustainable plant production. We train and research plants for food, feed and energy. The research examines how different production methods, cultivation environments and systems affect yields and other ecosystem services, as well as product quality and the surrounding environment. The department has operations in both Uppsala and Umeå and is also responsible for the Lövsta and Röbäcksdalen field stations. Röbäcksdalen is a research center close to the city that is a unique environment for applied research in environmental, ecological and agricultural sciences. description: Tasks: We now need to supplement the workforce with you who want to contribute to the development of the cultural reserve Stensjö village. During the changes of the seasons, you will contribute to recreating the experience of old-time small farms in the Småland forest region. The position involves primary responsibility for agriculture and animal husbandry in a landscape characterized by natural grazing, mowing fields, small fields and large forest areas. All cultivation is organic. You must be prepared to take on managerial responsibilities. The permanent staff at the farm consists of four people with different areas of responsibility (agriculture, forestry, garden, landscape), one of whom is site manager with overall responsibility for the property. During the growing season, the workforce is supplemented by one to two seasonal workers. The animal supervision on the weekends rotates between the staff so that work takes place according to schedule every third to fourth weekend. Common, ongoing work tasks consist of all tasks occurring within a farm with an ecological orientation and a focus on cultural-historical landscape care. An important task is to continuously document the work that is done. Passing on knowledge of the uniqueness of Stensjö village to visitors and groups is also part of the work. Participation in management councils and ongoing contacts with the County Administrative Board regarding issues relating to the cultural reserve are included, as well as administrative work and authority contacts related to the duties, such as EU and other applications, reporting and registration. Programs used at Stensjö include Dataväxt, Växa Sverige, CDB, Elitlamm etc. About Stensjö village Stensjö village comprises 576 hectares of which 14 hectares are arable, 81 hectares of pasture, 417 hectares of forest and 44 hectares of impediment. The large contiguous areas with natural pastures are distinctive for Stensjö village. A typical feature is the kilometre-long hedgerows that enclose holdings, pastures and cattle lanes. Small fields, mowing fields, pastures and open fields with forest grazing characterize the landscape. The village's great importance lies in the fact that houses and property form a unit that is original. Residential houses and outbuildings, a total of about 50 in number, are gathered in a cluster village, which was common in many places in Småland before legal transfer was carried out in the 19th century. In the village there are about fifteen cows and a bull of the red kulla breed as well as about 30 Helsingo sheep, some pigs and chickens. During the summer months, hired cows walk in the forest pastures. The field cultivation consists of paddy, potatoes and cultivated crops, mainly older cereals but also flax. The land has been cultivated organically since the Vitterhetsakademien took over the property in the 1960s. Since 2020, Stensjö village is a cultural reserve. The management plan aims to show Stensjö as it looked at the turn of the century in 1900. The land types that existed at that time should be well represented in the form of pastures, fodder dikes, gardens, ancient fields with cereal crops, natural hay fields and forest pastures. Long-term work is underway where the management plan is the guiding principle with the aim of recreating an older land use. Stensjö village is to be developed into a knowledge and development center for historic landscape use. The management plan can be found on the website under the Management plan and documents tab. To support the work, there is a management council that meets at Stensjö twice a year. The maintenance council consists of 5-7 people with experience in practical landscape and garden maintenance and building maintenance, as well as representatives for research in relevant areas. jobId: 156744
title: Tractor and machine operator for Widegrens Gård on Gotland
description: About usWidegrens Gård on Gotland specializes in the organic cultivation of potatoes, carrots and onions with our own packing plant where we wash, sort and pack the products. In addition to this, there is also the cultivation of grain and rapeseed. Our carrot packing house is in Atlingbo and our potato and onion packing house is in Follingbo. The cultivation, which is completely organic, is spread over central Gotland. We are today 45 employees who work together all year round towards high goals. Today, 12 machine operators work in our cultivation team, led by our team leader Marcus and cultivation manager Jakob. In the summer, we are reinforced by around 180 summer workers in manual cleaning of our organic cultivations. the coffee room. We are a smoke-free company. As an employee with us, you get the work and protective clothing you need in your role with us. We have a management team that is seen continuously where we constantly try to develop and improve the company. The management team includes the following roles CEO, cultivation manager, HR manager, Team leader Sylfaste, Team leader Atlingbo, Team leader Cultivation, We ourselves would like to describe ourselves as a stable growing company where much is still undone and the opportunities are great. We are informal and straightforward with a short chain of command in a flat structure. We are aware that our employees are the most important thing we have and that it is people who build the company. Together as a team, we try to implement the goals and visions we have for the business. You who apply to us should enjoy teamwork in a lively environment with lots of humor and laughter in a serious world between too little or too much rain at the right or wrong time. About the positionWe are now looking for new important pieces of the puzzle for our cultivation team! The team currently consists of 12 machine operators, but when this year's cultivation season is over, two valued employees in the team move on to their own businesses. It is the most common reason that people leave us, they come from agricultural school or another job and stay with us for a few years and then move on to their own business. You should be very interested in crop cultivation and agricultural machinery. Inspired by the feeling of being part of a larger work team where you share challenges together, strive towards high goals without having far to laugh. The work consists of many different tasks in crop cultivation such as, for example, rotary harrowing, sowing of root vegetables, planting potatoes and onions, stone rowing, mechanical weed control, harrowing, chopping, milling and cupping, ploughing, cultivation, sowing of cereals, harvesting of potatoes and root vegetables, transport of products from fields to our cold storage, moving and commissioning irrigation machines and much more. The growing season with us runs roughly between 1 April- 15 November and as a machine operator with us, during this period you are basically all the time in a tractor in a field to help the crops reach their full potential. At other times of the year, it is service and maintenance of the machinery in the workshop, improvements to outbuildings, trucking and transport between our various warehouses. We solve a large part of the tasks in teams, but there are also many tasks that are solved on your own when you have warmed up in the clothes. It is a prerequisite that you have experience driving agricultural machines, that you can drive them skillfully without damaging either the crop, the machine or the surroundings. Your attitude and desire to develop with us is strong and the commitment to do your part the best is a matter of course. You are welcome to describe yourself as driven, humorous, in a good mood even if you are busy and that you have your heart in the relationship with colleagues, products and partners. The position is a full-time position all year round. the application is positive. The position can be filled before the application deadline. Entry date for the position by agreement based on how your conditions look today but no later than 15 March 2025. Salary according to increase. For the right applicant who does not currently live on Gotland, we can actively help find accommodation through our local network, several people in our existing team have come from the mainland in recent years. The application is emailed to jobb@widegrens.se

title: Work with plant protection - three services in our socially important business
description: The Swedish Agency for Agriculture exists to promote increased and sustainable food production and good animal welfare throughout Sweden. We contribute to a living countryside. About 1,750 people work with us. The head office is in Jönköping, but we also have large regional operations. Read more about what it's like to work at Jordbruksverket on our website: www. the agricultural agency. se/jobbahososs As an advisor in plant protection, you will be part of the plant protection center in Skara, which is part of the environment and climate knowledge hub and works to actively influence and contribute to sustainable plant protection and a competitive, profitable and increased food production. We work in teams and help each other with the tasks that need to be carried out. The colleagues in the environment and climate knowledge hub are mainly located regionally at the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's three advisory units. This position is located at the plant protection advisory unit, which includes the plant protection centre. At the plant control unit, where the administrative positions are located, we are responsible for managing, among other things the rules for seed and against plant pests. This means everything from EU and international work, to national regulations and decisions, together with a lot of guidance, information and preparedness work. At the unit, we are 18 employees divided into two teams. We work both directly with industry players, industry organizations and in collaboration with the government office and other member states. JOB TASKS Do you have a good knowledge of the challenges of plant cultivation and want to work for robust and sustainable plant protection? Do you want to contribute to us being able to continue growing crops for feed and food in Sweden even in the event of social disturbances and in a changed climate? Then you can become one of our new colleagues! The Swedish Agency for Agriculture has an important task in both working with preventive plant protection and combating plant pests that are already present here, partly through regulations and partly through advice and skills development. We are now advertising three positions with the following tasks: 1. Advisor crop protection, agriculture - Skara• compile and convey Swedish and international experiences and results in the field of plant protection to the consultancy, • support the consultancy with increased competence through newsletters, control recommendations, courses, field trips and conferences, • follow the development of plant pests during the season within the Swedish Agency for Agriculture's forecasting activities for various pests, • increase awareness of difficult-to-control weeds and spread knowledge about sustainable cultivation systems, • be an important part of various projects within preparedness to ensure that we can maintain Swedish food production2. Plant pest manager - Jönköping/Landskrona• guide and inform about our rules against quarantine pests, • strengthen our preparedness for and manage possible outbreaks, • contribute to planning and developing our inventory of quarantine pests. Together with the colleagues at the plant regulation unit, you protect Sweden against the introduction of new plant pests. The work involves a mixture of situations that requires quick responses and planned work with processes based on scouting and reflection. 3. Manager robust crop cultivation - Jönköping• what abilities are needed to run the business, • what vulnerabilities exist and • what we need to do to increase our ability. Together with colleagues, you contribute to making our socially important business more robust with rules and guidance both on seed and combating plant pests. This is to reduce our vulnerability and strengthen our preparedness to face new as well as ongoing challenges.
